title.en: H Company releases Holo4 computer-use model family
title.zhHans: H Company 发布 Holo4 计算机操作模型系列

searchSummary.en: H Company released Holo4-27B and Holo4-35B-A3B for computer-use tasks across graphical interfaces, code, MCP, and APIs, with different licenses for the two checkpoints.
searchSummary.zhHans: H Company 发布面向图形界面、代码、MCP 与 API 操作的 Holo4-27B 和 Holo4-35B-A3B，两款检查点采用不同许可证。

summary.en: On September 28, 2026, H Company released the Holo4 computer-use model family. The release includes a dense 27B model under CC BY-NC 4.0 and a 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts model under Apache 2.0, with hosted API access and downloadable weight variants.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 9 月 28 日，H Company 发布 Holo4 计算机操作模型系列。其中包括采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 的 27B 稠密模型，以及采用 Apache 2.0 的 35B-A3B 混合专家模型，并提供托管 API 与多种可下载权重版本。

narrative.en: Holo4 is designed to move between screenshots, code execution, MCP tools, and APIs within the same agent workflow. H Company released evaluation trajectories that improve auditability, but the benchmark results remain vendor-run and do not establish independent task replication or production adoption. The license split also means “open weight” does not imply the same commercial rights across the family.
narrative.zhHans: Holo4 被设计为在同一智能体工作流中切换屏幕操作、代码执行、MCP 工具与 API。H Company 公开了评测轨迹，提高了可审计性，但跑分仍由厂商执行，不能证明独立任务复现或生产采用。许可证差异也意味着“开放权重”并不代表系列内各模型拥有相同商业权利。

text.en: H Company released Holo4-27B and Holo4-35B-A3B as downloadable computer-use models on September 28, 2026.
text.zhHans: H Company 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日发布可下载的计算机操作模型 Holo4-27B 与 Holo4-35B-A3B。

text.en: Holo4-27B uses a non-commercial CC BY-NC 4.0 license while Holo4-35B-A3B uses Apache 2.0; benchmark results remain vendor-run.
text.zhHans: Holo4-27B 采用非商业 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可证，Holo4-35B-A3B 采用 Apache 2.0；相关跑分仍由厂商执行。
